title: Mindbrain
summary: A calm analytics workspace for turning busy data into clear next steps.
description: Aurora is a small dashboard concept designed around hierarchy, quick scanning, and a comfortable rhythm for repeated daily use.
imageAlt: Abstract analytics dashboard with a coral chart and pale green data cards

highlights.label: Structure
highlights.body: Built a responsive card system that keeps the most important metrics visible without crowding the screen.

highlights.label: Interaction
highlights.body: Added focused hover and keyboard states so the dashboard remains useful without relying on decorative motion.

title: Field Notes
summary: A lightweight reading experience for collecting observations, places, and small stories.
description: Field Notes explores how a personal archive can feel warm and tactile while remaining easy to browse on a small screen.
imageAlt: Editorial notes layout with a warm paper background and green index tabs

highlights.label: Typography
highlights.body: Created a clear contrast between expressive headings and a practical reading measure for longer notes.

highlights.label: Responsive work
highlights.body: Reworked the desktop index into a single-column mobile reading flow instead of simply shrinking the layout.

title: Atlas Commerce
summary: A focused storefront concept that makes browsing feel simple, visual, and intentional.
description: Atlas is a commerce interface exercise focused on product discovery, clear states, and a checkout path with less friction.
imageAlt: Minimal commerce grid with a bright orange product block and navigation rail

highlights.label: Product browsing
highlights.body: Used consistent image ratios and metadata placement to make a mixed product grid feel predictable.

highlights.label: States
highlights.body: Mapped empty, selected, and loading states before styling so the interface stays understandable beyond the happy path.

title: Studio Forms
summary: A friendly form builder concept for teams that need structure without the clutter.
description: Studio Forms is a small internal-tool concept that turns repetitive form setup into a more focused and legible flow.
imageAlt: Form builder interface with stacked fields and a blue preview panel

highlights.label: Components
highlights.body: Separated field primitives from page-level composition so the same controls can grow with the product.

highlights.label: Usability
highlights.body: Kept labels, validation messaging, and keyboard order explicit in the interface structure.

title: Pulse Planner
summary: A quiet weekly planning interface for seeing priorities without overloading the calendar.
description: Pulse Planner is a small productivity concept where the visual system is intentionally restrained to keep attention on the work itself.
imageAlt: Weekly planning board with a dark navy sidebar and lavender task cards

highlights.label: Layout
highlights.body: Designed the week view as a flexible grid that collapses into a readable list on smaller screens.

highlights.label: Feedback
highlights.body: Used color and small status changes to confirm actions without adding noisy notifications.
